head: fa022fdffa25ec93d8c8c324f20889e526fdf498
commit_message:
Freeze original schema RPC generator source and tool provenance

Preserve five source-reviewed RPC inputs and the original generator route.
Prepare isolated baseline/candidate generation with exact tool pins,
fresh outputs, finite owned drain and limited message compilation.
Generation and production SDK integration remain unexecuted.

response.content:
name: Original schema RPC source generation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/otzaria-schema-rpc-generation-20261122
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/otzaria-schema-rpc-generation.yml
      - docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122/generate_original_schema_rpc.py
      - docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122/EXECUTION_INPUTS.json
      - docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122/TOOL_PINS.json
      - docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122/native/pb/**/*.proto

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: otzaria-schema-rpc-generation-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate-original-rpc:
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_27.app/Contents/Developer
    steps:
      - name: Fix absolute owned generation deadline
        run: |
          echo "OTZARIA_SCHEMA_RPC_JOB_DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + 6900 ))" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Checkout reviewed control source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /.github/workflows/otzaria-schema-rpc-generation.yml
            /docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122/
            /docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-native-defaults-20261122/run_native_defaults_repair.py
      - name: Select actual ARM64 Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          architecture: arm64
      - name: Install exact original Go toolchain
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          cache: false
      - name: Checkout immutable original Heart
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: anyproto/anytype-heart
          ref: d98420b1113536afd08cde6de9a5816f6d27ffff
          path: build/Schema-RPC-Inputs/heart
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout immutable original SDK generator source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 3be6ecab805b17e2c90fee897fdab45a0b03bfdc
          path: build/Schema-RPC-Inputs/swift
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /Makefile
            /Scripts/
            /Modules/ProtobufMessages/
            /Modules/Services/
            /Tools/anytype-swift-codegen
            /Tools/anytype-swift-filesplit/
      - name: Checkout exact original SwiftProtobuf source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: apple/swift-protobuf
          ref: c6fe6442e6a64250495669325044052e113e990c
          path: build/Schema-RPC-Inputs/swift-protobuf
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Generate baseline and candidate through original routes
        run: |
          python3 docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122/generate_original_schema_rpc.py \
            --control-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --control-head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --packet docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-rpc-generation-20261122 \
            --manifest-sha256 800c0745ddc36537c443e17f9d984c98a11fd22c4d825c4a935ffa4f8d264ee3 \
            --support docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-annotation-schema-native-defaults-20261122/run_native_defaults_repair.py \
            --heart-input build/Schema-RPC-Inputs/heart \
            --swift-input build/Schema-RPC-Inputs/swift \
            --plugin-input build/Schema-RPC-Inputs/swift-protobuf \
            --work build/Schema-RPC-Owned-Work \
            --evidence build/Schema-RPC-Generation-Evidence \
            --job-deadline-unix "$OTZARIA_SCHEMA_RPC_JOB_DEADLINE"
      - name: Retain generated source and original failure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Otzaria-Schema-RPC-Generation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/Schema-RPC-Generation-Evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 6
          retention-days: 14

conclusion: No Actions run or GitHub Actions check suite was observed after more than five minutes following one verified normal branch push. The exact workflow source and branch are present, the commit has no skip-CI marker, and no invalid-workflow check was reported. Workflow metadata lookup returns HTTP 404. The remote routing cause is not established.
